20052.factory_part_name: Arcooda Parts 20052 29 Inch CRT Replacement Bracket
20052.long_desc:
Our general 26inch 1440x1080 29inch CRT Monitor Bracket is designed to be used with our 26inch 4x3 aspect ratio when replacing your 29inch CRT tube monitor. This 29" CRT to LCD conversion monitor bracket support candy cabinets. When it is finally time to swap that heavy tube for a modern, crisp LCD, the biggest headache is making it fit without ruining the look of your machine. This custom 29-inch CRT-to-LCD Replacement Bracket solves that exact problem. Keep the candy sweet. Lose the CRT weight. The Perfect Fit for Sega & Konami Classics
  • Engineered specifically for 29inch CRT tube monitor replacement for candy cabinets as well as general arcade machines.
  • Tailored Compatibility: Drop-in ready for the iconic Sega Blast City, Sega Naomi Universal, and Konami Windy cabinets.
  • Factory Alignment: Mounts directly to the original chassis mounting points.
  • Reversible Orientation: Easily flip the bracket to accommodate standard horizontal layouts or vertical "Tate" mode for shmup-heavy setups.
  • making monitor adjustments from the front of machine are super easy, connect your extension monitor OSD and IR sensor into the metal bracket
    • The 29inch CRT general monitor brackets include 2pcs, and will have fixed position mounting. Please Note: The mounting hole positions in the monitor mounting brackets have been designed used 29inch CRT frames, and arcade machine measurements either in our own testing, or provided to us by our loyal customers. We cannot 100% guarantee the brackets will work perfectly for all applications, but we will continue to refine and improve the brackets with your kind feedback. The Universal Arcade Monitor Bracket is perfectly paired with the Arcooda 26-inch 1440x1080 Monitor. This monitor has been designed with wider front metal bezel to cover any mismatches between the 26inch LCD monitor's viewing size and the 27inch view size of the 29inch CRT tube. Please review the full range of monitor mounting brackets to match your application.
